title: THE CONTROLS LIST STANDS BESIDE THE FEED
why: Seen in the first picture of the busy raid frame: with the feed at the bottom left, the compact controls list was pushed up above it and ran over the bottom of the CURRENT PILLAGERS board. It now stands on the vitals as before, but to the right of the feed, and it shrinks a little if it must so that it ends before the middle of the screen, where the player stands. The one-line controls hint stands just over the feed.
now: The compact controls list now stands to the right of the feed, clear of the pillagers board.
